## MCP - News Searcher (GNews)

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/news-searcher

**Parameters:**
- `query` (required): Search query
- `gnews_api_key` (required): GNews API key
- `options.language` (optional): fr | en | de | es... (default: fr)
- `options.country` (optional): fr | us | gb... (default: fr)
- `options.max_results` (optional): 1-100 (default: 10)
- `options.from_date` (optional): ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- `options.to_date` (optional): ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- `options.sort_by` (optional): publishedAt | relevance (default: publishedAt)
- `execution_mode` (optional): online | offline

**Returns:** List of news articles with title, description, content, source

**Note:** GNews free tier: 100 requests/day
